01 / About

Practical support, grounded in experience.

I support recruitment teams and businesses with the coordination, documentation, and administrative work that keeps people and processes moving.

My background spans recruitment, virtual assistance, and administrative support, with experience in local and overseas clients, and managing day-to-day remote business operations.

My recruitment experience covers various industries and job positions, including candidate sourcing, screening, interview coordination, onboarding, records management, and close collaboration with internal recruitment teams.
